High QPS during business hours (expected 60-150 qps). Need low tail latency, deterministic costs for forecasting, and SSO + audit capabilities for enterprise customers.
requirements: Indexing scale: ~1.5-2.5M documents, incremental daily updates (~5-10k/day)
Latency targets: P95 rerank <150ms; end-to-end search (embed+ANN+rerank) <250ms preferred
Throughput: sustain 100 qps baseline; burst to 180 qps for peak windows
Cost sensitivity: target blended cost-per-query (embed+ann+rerank) < $0.003 — needs tradeoffs vs quality
Model preferences: prefer open 7B-13B family for rerank; embeddings 1536-d or 1024-d depending on storage
Routing/fallback: automatic fallback to smaller model if capacity constrained; canary rollouts for model changes
Security/compliance: SSO/SAML, tenant isolation in logs, audit logging and optional EU data residency
